facts.business: Modern Threads (India) Limited is engaged in trading derivative financial instruments including equity, currency, and commodity futures and options, and holds investments in mutual funds and debentures.

auditor.name: Not stated in the provided text
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Qualified opinion due to: (i) Non-provision of interest (dividend) on cumulative redeemable preference shares amounting to Rs. 36.13 Lakhs for the year (Rs. 1083.87 Lakhs up to 31.03.2026); (ii) Balances of trade payables and trade receivables subject to confirmation and consequential adjustments. Key Audit Matter: Accounting and Valuation of Derivative Financial Instruments (Futures & Options).

key_risks: Non-provision of interest on cumulative redeemable preference shares
Trade payables and receivables subject to confirmation
High volume and frequency of derivative trading requiring robust internal systems
Compliance with exchange margining and regulatory provisions for derivatives
facts.related_party_note: All related party transactions during the financial year were on arm's length basis and in the ordinary course of business. No material significant related party transactions with potential conflict of interest. Omnibus approval obtained for repetitive transactions. Details in Note No. 37 to Financial Statements and Form AOC-2 as Annexure-E.
